card.title: PANZER I-B
card.text: Becomes Veteran when it damages the enemy HQ.
card.flavorText: The Panzer I-B, aka Panzerkampfwagen I Ausf.B,  was a light tank developed by Germany in the 1930s, and it was an improved version of the Panzer I-A tank. The Panzer I-B was armed with a 7.92mm machine gun and had a crew of two. It had a top speed of 40 km/h (25 mph) and a range of around 150 km (93 mi). The Panzer I-B was produced between 1934 and 1935, with approximately 400 units built, including variants. It saw action in the Spanish Civil War and the early stages of WWII. However, due to its light armor and inadequate armament, it was quickly outdated and outclassed by newer tank designs. As a result, the Panzer I-B was gradually phased out of service and replaced by more advanced tanks such as the Panzer II. Overall, the Panzer I-B played a limited role in WWII, but it was an important step in the development of German tank technology and helped pave the way for future designs.
